niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, polished interfaces with strong structure and scanability: clear section hierarchy, full-width list rows or well-organized modular grouping, integrated headers/search, complete and populated screens, restrained pastel accents, and low-noise layouts. They often favor light, airy, contemporary presentation, but in some contexts also respond positively to sleek dark, immersive, high-contrast designs when they feel cohesive, premium, and controlled rather than cluttered.

criteria.description: Prefers interfaces with clearly separated, labeled sections and an obvious top-down information hierarchy.
Prefers fully populated, resolved screens with enough visible options or content to feel complete rather than sparse or placeholder-like.
Prefers search bars and top navigation/header elements that feel naturally integrated into a structured header area rather than detached or visually pasted on.
Prefers a calmer, softer, more contemporary and polished visual mood over harsher, blunter, or more utilitarian presentation.
Prefers cleaner compositions with fewer competing modules, less intrusive chrome, and more focused decision paths.
Prefers restrained, cohesive icon accents—often pastel or softly colored—rather than arbitrary, loud, or inconsistent color use.
Prefers settings/content arranged in easy-to-scan rows with dividers and consistent line-by-line rhythm rather than fragmented presentation that interrupts vertical scanning.
Prefers content broken into distinct, digestible modules or cards when that improves grouping, readability, and focus.
Prefers even spacing and breathable layout rhythm that feels intentional and balanced, avoiding both cramped compression and awkward empty gaps.
Prefers standardized row behaviors and control patterns, with clear action hierarchy and fewer competing actions per item.
